name: ts-r-code-review
description: ts-r pull request review for Claude and OpenAI models: lenses for bugs, AGENTS.md and design-record rules, resource limits, determinism and hot-path performance, with verified, confidence-scored findings

interface.shortDescription: Review ts-r changes against AGENTS.md and design records
interface.longDescription: Reviews the working tree, a branch or a pull request into main for verified bugs and breaches of ts-r's rules: the from-scratch rule, never panicking on user input, determinism, resource limits, hot-path performance and design records. The same skill drives the code-review GitHub workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use ts-r-review to review my branch against main
